title: C standard library reimplementation
description: Rebuilt a subset of the C standard library (string, memory and linked-list functions) as a reusable static library, without external dependencies.

title: Formatted output with variadic functions in C
description: Reimplemented printf from scratch with variadic arguments, handling conversions for characters, strings, integers, pointers and hexadecimal.

title: Buffered line reader in C
description: Reads any file descriptor one line at a time, with static state, a configurable buffer size and careful memory management.

title: Linux server setup and hardening
description: Installed and configured a Debian or Rocky Linux virtual machine with encrypted LVM partitions, SSH, a firewall, a strict password policy, sudo logging and a monitoring script.

title: Sorting algorithm optimisation
description: Sorts integers using two stacks and a limited set of operations, minimising the number of moves. Focused on algorithmic complexity.

title: Unix pipes and process management
description: Reproduces shell pipelines in C with fork, execve, pipe and dup2, including file redirections and error handling.

title: Inter-process communication with signals
description: Client–server messaging in C that sends data bit by bit using only UNIX signals.

title: 2D game with a graphics library
description: A small tile-based 2D game in C using the MiniLibX graphics library: map parsing and validation, rendering and keyboard events.

title: 3D wireframe renderer
description: Renders a height map as an isometric 3D wireframe in C, with projection maths and a graphics library.

title: Interactive fractal explorer
description: Renders the Mandelbrot and Julia sets in C with zoom and colour, using complex-number maths and a graphics library.

title: Concurrency with threads and mutexes
description: Solves the dining philosophers problem in C with POSIX threads and mutexes, avoiding deadlocks and data races.

title: Unix shell in C
description: A Bash-like command-line interpreter in C: parsing with quotes and environment variables, pipes, redirections, heredocs, built-in commands and signal handling. Team project.

title: TCP/IP networking fundamentals
description: Configured small networks by solving exercises on IP addressing, subnet masks and routing.

title: Raycasting 3D engine
description: A first-person 3D maze in C using raycasting, in the style of Wolfenstein 3D, with textured walls and map parsing.

title: Ray tracer
description: A ray tracer in C that renders scenes of spheres, planes and cylinders with lights, shadows and a camera, described in a scene file.

title: Object-oriented programming in C++
description: Ten modules introducing C++98: classes, memory, operator overloading, inheritance and polymorphism, exceptions, casts, templates and the STL.

title: Containerised infrastructure with Docker
description: A small infrastructure built with Docker Compose from custom Dockerfiles: NGINX with TLS, WordPress with PHP-FPM and MariaDB, each in its own container.

title: HTTP server in C++
description: An HTTP/1.1 web server in C++ with non-blocking I/O, a configuration file, static files, uploads and CGI. Team project.

title: IRC server in C++
description: An IRC server in C++ that handles many clients with non-blocking sockets and poll, with channels, operators and the core IRC commands. Team project.

title: Full-stack web application
description: A team-built web application for real-time online Pong, with user accounts, authentication, live multiplayer and chat.
